points.identity_evidence: Blair River lower eastern tributary, before the river turns north towards the first large western tributary and the upper hairpin. Historical tributary much shorter; proposal requires wider branch-order review.
points.rejection_reason: The short historical east tributary may correspond to the modern long southeast tributary, but nearby modern northern forks are absent historically; exact branch order cannot be established from inspected broad context.

points.identity_evidence: Historical South Branch / modern Polletts Cove River prominent northeastern tributary before the main river continues east/southeast. Tributary length and additional modern branches differ; wider review required.
points.rejection_reason: Historical west-to-east main river and northern fork do not establish the chosen modern northwest-to-southeast main channel and northeast fork; branch order and bend geometry conflict.
